translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: Ayic sb'itan jun b'it tic vin̈ cuchb'um yic b'it, a yamc'ab' ay sch'an̈al sc'anchaji. Sb'it jun tic vin̈aj David.

content.text: Ach in Diosal, il in coti. Tz'el vav yuj yaelal tzin ic'ani. Cha ab' in lesal.
Ato b'aj slajvic'och sti' lum luum tic tzin avaj d'ayach, tz'el yip in pixan svab'i. Ic' in q'ue d'a yib'an̈ junoc nivan q'ueen yic tzin colchaji.
A ach ayachoch in colnab'iloc. Icha junoc cuartel aj d'ayin, tzin a col d'a eb' ayoch ajc'olal d'ayin.
In gana tzin cajnaj d'a a cajnub' d'a masanil tiempo. In gana tzin c'ub'ej in b'a d'a yalan̈ a vach'c'olal, icha noc' yunetac caxlan̈ d'a yalan̈ sc'axil snun.
Ach in Diosal, ab'nac tas in ti' vac'nac d'ayach, ix ac' in macb'en yed' eb' ay elc'och d'ay.
Najatocab' tzutej in q'uinal a in rey in tic. Nivanocab' ab'il svila'
yic svac'an yajalil d'a ichan̈. Tan̈vej in yed' a vach'c'olal, yujto tz'eln̈ejc'och tas tzala'.
Icha chi' ol ach in b'itej d'a masanil tiempo. Junjun c'u ol in c'anab'ajan b'aj vac'nac in ti' chi' d'ayach.
